name: firmware
label: Firmware (Uhr, C/C++, Cortex-M)
context: Cortex-M firmware in C and C++ on a wrist-worn device used in a clinical study. It records health data from identifiable trial participants, stores it on NAND flash, and transfers it over BLE to a phone app. The BLE radio is a u-blox ANNA-B112 module driven over an AT command interface.
threat_model: Attacker within BLE radio range for a few minutes
Attacker in physical possession of a watch, with a debug probe, able to desolder the flash
A malicious or spoofed phone app talking to the watch
Someone who obtains an OTA image and tries to get modified firmware onto a device
surfaces: BLE link security, GATT permissions and pairing
AT parser and BLE module driver as external input
protobuf and measurement data path including NAND storage
build configuration, debug interfaces and the update path
